scope: Independent fixed-rate, explicitly supplied-format immutable stereo accessor reconstruction and matching-rate timeline integration. This is not proof of selected Cubase backend format/rate, runtime playback or postterminal continuation.
independent_method: Seek and budget expectations use integer/Fraction IEEE rounding, including Float32 rate division before Double seek arithmetic. Candidate C and Swift accessor are not called to produce expectations.

Retained mode1 samples use the prior independently transcribed tap/history model with exact Fraction arithmetic and shared host sin/sqrt; retained mode2 uses an independent wrapper with the same pinned public SoXR backend. This isolates wrapper/state composition, not the shared transcendental/library implementation.

Original seek 10036f89c and read 10036eff0 instruction words were freshly compared with the pinned Mach-O bytes. Inspected first-budget, flush predicate, source-position update and seek branches match the bounded handoff.
Conditional PCM24 stage has a separate 681-vector optimized and UBSan control record. Both copies of the application format C/header exactly match that reviewed candidate.
accepted_observations: 105 seek controls include the Float32-ratio discriminator 44100 to 48000, requested 48000: stored source 44099 and returned output 47998. Seek changes position only; reads after backward/nonsequential seek retain prior mode1/mode2 history and first-budget state.

The ten sequences match all requested/budget/actual/returned counts, source cursors, first flags, EOF predicate and 4576 output Float32 words. Full first read exactly reaching source EOF does not invent terminal=true; only first short unequal-rate source read does.
Zero source budget consumes the first flag and calls no converter. Mode2 allowance is explicit supplied context separate from selected fallback child, not a backend availability claim.

PCM24 source admission rejects impossible negative zero, off-grid and out-of-range decoded values. The intermediate downsample quantizer still intentionally maps negative zero to positive integer zero.

Preflight errors preserve cursor/first/failure status; conversion errors poison the accessor because child state may already change. Terminal-state continuation is deliberately rejected rather than reset or preroll.
Immutable source and returned copies are isolated. Equal Float32 direct reads preserve first flag and return actual short counts; equal PCM24 format path consumes it.

Matching-rate timeline integration keeps one active descriptor accessor across blocks and releases it on changed/nil selection, including after a skipped descriptor. Full read counts are required, segment gain follows read once, and the output block is published only after success.

retained_test_development.outcome: Compile failure only: test attempted to mutate immutable Read.samples. Corrected to mutate a detached value copy; no production edit.

All numerical/sample/state expectations passed; 12 raw-byte assertions compared unspecified C-struct padding through Swift value copies. Corrected to inspect stable allocated sentinel-filled storage directly, retaining full byte-transactionality coverage.
All seven tests passed; numerical expected values and oracle hash unchanged.

limits: No Cubase runtime execution, proprietary PCM comparison, vendor-library identity or whole-project fidelity claim.

Source/backend format and reader-owner current rate remain explicit context; a stored PCM24 WAV or project rate does not establish the live selected stream. The current native timeline integration remains matching-rate only.
Only unity accessor gain, immutable stereo memory source, fixed integral 8000..192000 rates, bounded requests, nearest supported arm64 FP environment and the admitted format paths are implemented.

Backend seek mismatch, transient error and retry are not injected through this immutable-memory accessor. Native special retry is separately planned by the existing timeline primitive; arbitrary backend errors and mutation are not reconstructed.
Postterminal mode1 continuation and mode2 backend lifecycle remain excluded. Mode2 zero-input nonterminal remains a defensive rejection; the accessor poisons rather than adding flush or padding.

A successful returned-count query or sample test does not certify real-time scheduling, concurrency, dynamic rate changes, channel/format changes, current backend availability or alternate host callbacks.
Shared public SoXR and host transcendental dependencies are explicit. Sanitizer/control results are bounded tests, not proof for untested memory states.
